```{python}
#| label: load-manifest
import json
from pathlib import Path

MANIFEST = Path("../website/assets/inferences_metal/manifest.json")
ASSETS_PREFIX = "assets/inferences_metal"

manifest = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if MANIFEST.exists() else []
```

This page walks through three frames from the production cascade — one for
each behaviour the architecture is designed to produce. Every panel is
generated from the actual end-to-end trace at
[`reports/eval_cascade_metal_k1_calibrated.jsonl`](https://github.com/j-jayes/Scratching-the-Surface/blob/main/reports)
by [`scripts/render_inference_panels_metal.py`](https://github.com/j-jayes/Scratching-the-Surface/blob/main/scripts/render_inference_panels_metal.py).

For each example you get three panels:

1. **Input** — the raw frame as the camera saw it, resized for display.
2. **PatchCore heatmap** — per-patch cosine distance to the nearest
   neighbours in the domain memory bank, overlaid in inferno colourmap.
   Bright regions are "looks unlike anything in the normal-distribution
   training pool".
3. **YOLO overlay** — top-3 detections from the production
   `models/yolo_metal/best.pt` (mAP50 0.50, trained 50 ep / 640 px on a T4
   in Phase J.4). Red is the highest-confidence box, amber are runners-up.

The trace beneath each example is the literal router output — same code paths
the live ACA app exercises, just re-run in-process for cheaper iteration.

```{python}
#| label: render-examples
#| output: asis
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

if not manifest:
    display(Markdown(
        "*Walkthroughs pending — run "
        "`scripts/render_inference_panels_metal.py` after the next cascade "
        "evaluation to populate this page.*"
    ))
else:
    for ex in manifest:
        md = []
        md.append(f"## {ex['headline']}\n")
        md.append(
            f"*Track {ex['track']}, domain `{ex['domain']}`, "
            f"true polarity `{ex['true_polarity']}`, "
            f"router stopped at L{ex['stopped_at_layer']} "
            f"(end-to-end {ex['client_elapsed_ms']} ms).*\n"
        )
        md.append(ex['summary'] + "\n")
        md.append(":::: {.column-page}")
        md.append("::: {layout-ncol=3}")
        md.append(f"![Input frame]({ASSETS_PREFIX}/{ex['id']}/input.jpg)")
        md.append(
            f"![PatchCore anomaly heatmap (p99 score "
            f"{ex['patchcore_heatmap']['score_p99']:.3f})]"
            f"({ASSETS_PREFIX}/{ex['id']}/heatmap.jpg)"
        )
        md.append(
            f"![YOLO production detections "
            f"(n={ex['yolo_overlay']['n_total']})]"
            f"({ASSETS_PREFIX}/{ex['id']}/yolo.jpg)"
        )
        md.append(":::")
        md.append("::::\n")

        md.append("**Router trace**")
        md.append("")
        md.append("| Layer | Decision | Class | Score | Latency |")
        md.append("|---|---|---|---|---|")
        for ent in ex['trace']:
            layer = ent.get('layer', '?')
            dec = ent.get('decision', '-')
            cls = ent.get('class', '-')
            if ent.get('layer') == 1:
                score = (
                    f"z={ent.get('score_z'):.2f} (τ={ent.get('z_threshold')})"
                    if ent.get('score_z') is not None else "-"
                )
            elif ent.get('layer') == 2:
                score = (
                    f"conf={ent.get('confidence', 0):.2f}, "
                    f"n={ent.get('n_detections', 0)}"
                )
            elif ent.get('layer') == 3:
                score = f"conf={ent.get('confidence', 0):.2f}"
            else:
                score = "-"
            ms = ent.get('elapsed_ms', '?')
            md.append(f"| L{layer} | {dec} | {cls} | {score} | {ms} ms |")
        md.append("")

        oracle_entries = [
            e for e in ex['trace']
            if e.get('layer') == 3 and e.get('reasoning')
        ]
        if oracle_entries:
            md.append(f"> **Oracle reasoning:** *{oracle_entries[-1]['reasoning']}*\n")

        display(Markdown("\n".join(md)))
```

## Reading guide

When inspecting the panels:

- **PatchCore heatmaps on Track A defectives** should spotlight the region
  YOLO subsequently boxes. If the bright region sits anywhere YOLO ignores,
  the per-domain `τ` is too tight.
- **Heatmaps on Track A normals** should be mostly cold. Hot patches on
  clean steel are a sign the calibration was done against the wrong
  distribution.
- **Oracle reasoning strings** should reference the visible defect type
  rather than generic "surface irregularity" boilerplate. The few-shot
  prompt in
  [`oracle.py`](https://github.com/j-jayes/Scratching-the-Surface/blob/main/src/cascade_defect/layer3_gpt4o/oracle.py)
  was rewritten in J.2 around the Severstal+KSDD2 taxonomy specifically to
  ground the model.
- **YOLO box colours** — red is the top detection, amber are runners-up.
  Track B (KSDD2) frames are deliberately out-of-distribution for the
  Severstal-trained YOLO; expect noisy class labels that the Oracle then
  corrects.
